text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Satono Diamond wasn't feeling 
well, I decided to let her rest in the 
nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to worry you. I think I'll be 
fine after a little rest...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then, good night.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my, where in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text:
This is the Satono Group's new product 
unveiling. Welcome, Milady.

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text:
And now, we present our featured new 
product! Here is... the cybernetic 
racehorse girl, "Paka-gene"!

text_block_list.name: Pakazine
text_block_list.text: (Whirrr, clunk, kachunk!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! It's as if 3D polygons are 
popping right out of the screen...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text:
Now, please try operating it using this 
dedicated controller called the "Twin 
Lever"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, are you sure it's okay? ...Here 
goes♪

text_block_list.name: Pakazine
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrrooooom!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! It moved! Such incredible 
mobility, ufufu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text:
And so, please leave all future races to 
"PakaZine"! My lady, you can focus purely 
on the controls!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No way...! I cannot accept this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will run on my own! Everyone's 
expectations, the Satono family's 
long-cherished wish... I will answer them 
all with my own two legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah...!? A dream...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Still, these feelings are real. I can't 
just stand still!

Waking from her dream, Satono Diamond was 
overflowing with even more energy than 
before!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"At this speed... maybe it would be better 
to have a robot run instead...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she can live up to everyone's 
expectations better than I can...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh... W-Was it a dream?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...No, even if it was just a dream, why 
did I have such negative thoughts...?

Satono Diamond woke up on the wrong side 
of the bed and wasn't able to get enough 
rest...
